privacyPage.title: Privacy and cookie policy
privacyPage.intro: Information about data used when visiting this website, contacting Walter and choosing a language.
privacyPage.contactCopy: For questions about processing or requests concerning your rights, contact Walter's data protection officer.

scope.title: What this policy covers
scope.copy: This policy describes this website: information about dishes, menus, restaurants, catering and careers. There are no user accounts, online orders or payments here. The job application form prepares an email containing the details you enter; your mail app sends it, not this website's server. Delivery apps open through external links and have their own privacy notices.

data.title: Data when browsing and contacting us
data.copy: Loading pages, images, videos and PDF menus sends technical data to the server, such as your IP address, the requested file and browser information. If you choose email or telephone contact, you use your own mail or calling app and share the contact details and content you decide to provide. The website's contact dialog does not send or store a message.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal grounds
purposes.copy: Technical data is needed to display and securely operate the website. Information you provide when contacting us is used to consider and answer your enquiry. The legal ground depends on the circumstances: steps requested before entering a contract, legal obligations, or legitimate interests in communication and website security. Where consent is needed, it must be requested separately and can be withdrawn.

cookies.title: The language preference cookie
cookies.copy: The website uses the functional NEXT_LOCALE cookie to remember your chosen language on subsequent visits. This version has no analytics or advertising tools enabled. You can delete or block the cookie in your browser settings; you may then need to choose your language again. This page does not constitute consent to additional tracking.

external.title: Hosting and external services
external.copy: Hosting and communication providers participate in delivering the website and handling messages according to their roles. Social networks, app stores and external pages open through links. The restaurant map automatically loads OpenStreetMap tiles; the provider receives technical data such as your IP address and the requested map area. Device location is requested only when you press the nearest-restaurant button and grant browser permission. Coordinates are used in browser memory, without storage on our server. Opening directions sends Google Maps the selected destination and, if shared, your starting location. Check the privacy notice of the service you use.

retention.title: Retention and protection
retention.copy: Retention depends on the type of data, the purpose of communication and applicable legal obligations. This website does not specify a separate retention period for hosting or email service records. Ask the data protection officer for information about specific periods, recipients, possible international transfers and safeguards.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.copy: Subject to applicable law and the conditions for each right, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability, or object to processing. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing. Send requests to dpo@walter.rs. You may also complain to Serbia's Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection.

updates.title: Changes to this policy
updates.copy: This policy needs updating when website features, processing practices or legal requirements change. Introducing analytics, marketing, accounts or forms requires a fresh review of the notice and, where needed, appropriate consent before enabling those features.
